e.title: comorbidity
e.summary: 共病指数计算（CRAN 1.1.0）：加权 Charlson/Elixhauser 等共病评分——健康险风险调整的协变量工具
e.summary_en: Comorbidity score computation (CRAN 1.1.0): weighted Charlson/Elixhauser indices — covariate tool for health insurance risk adjustment
e.summary_hk: 共病指數計算（CRAN 1.1.0）：加權 Charlson/Elixhauser 等共病評分——健康險風險調整的協變量工具
e.body: comorbidity（CRAN 1.1.0）计算共病指数与评分：加权 Charlson、Elixhauser 等共病指数——基于 ICD 编码的健康风险度量。对 RIAA：健康险精算的协变量工程——共病指数是健康索赔预测/风险调整的标准协变量（[[hhs-hcc-sql]] 风险调整模型的输入特征）；Charlson/Elixhauser 在健康险定价与核保（[[insurance-uplift]]、[[insurance-survival]] 健康侧）中常用；与 [[actuarial-pricing]]（定价）配套；适合健康险精算方向。
e.body_en: comorbidity (CRAN 1.1.0) computes comorbidity indices and scores: weighted Charlson, Elixhauser and other comorbidity indices — health-risk measures based on ICD coding. For RIAA: covariate engineering for health insurance actuarial work — comorbidity indices are standard covariates for health claim prediction/risk adjustment (input features of [[hhs-hcc-sql]] risk adjustment); Charlson/Elixhauser are common in health pricing and underwriting (the health side of [[insurance-uplift]] and [[insurance-survival]]); pairs with [[actuarial-pricing]] (pricing); suits health insurance actuarial work.
e.body_hk: comorbidity（CRAN 1.1.0）計算共病指數與評分：加權 Charlson、Elixhauser 等共病指數——基於 ICD 編碼的健康風險度量。對 RIAA：健康險精算的協變量工程——共病指數是健康索賠預測/風險調整的標準協變量（[[hhs-hcc-sql]] 風險調整模型的輸入特徵）；Charlson/Elixhauser 在健康險定價與核保（[[insurance-uplift]]、[[insurance-survival]] 健康側）中常用；與、[[actuarial-pricing]]（定價）配套；適合健康險精算方向。
e.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v1.1.0，Charlson/Elixhauser 共病指数），未实测
